correctness.rationale: For a,b>=1, every mixed proper circular factor of 0^a1^b identifies its rotation via the oriented run boundary; pure-prefix sets and pure-suffix singleton completions must be separated, with the two run-boundary overlaps subtracted. Reconstructing this disjoint Myhill–Nerode quotient count gives q_0=q_n=1, q_d=2 min(a,b,d,n-d) for 0<d<n, and one dead quotient, so sc=2ab+3. The depth sum equals ab and balancing a+b maximizes ab. Independently recomputed all right-language quotients for each of 81 ordered pairs a,b=1..9, including a=b=1 and other boundary cases, and every profile matched. This finite confirmation is distinct from the all-a,b combinatorial proof. Git tree 9ca006a29e997775aa5bcb975803717467c0ab90 was independently reconstructed from the seven real blob IDs.
